description: This file defines the class EmployeeDistributionBySubunit within the OrangeHRM Dashboard module, serving as a Data Transfer Object (DTO) to encapsulate data related to employee distribution across subunits, including counts and limits.

classes.name: EmployeeDistributionBySubunit
classes.description: A data transfer object representing employee distribution metrics per subunit.

methods.name: getSubunitCountPairs
methods.description: Returns the list of subunit count pairs.

methods.name: getOtherEmployeeCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employees outside the listed subunits.

methods.name: getUnassignedEmployeeCount
methods.description: Returns the count of unassigned employees.

methods.name: getLimit
methods.description: Returns the limit threshold for display or processing.

methods.name: getTotalSubunitCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of subunits.
